Scripts.OnEnter: GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(CraftForge.L["Click to toggle favorite"], nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnLoad: self:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") self:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end
Scripts.OnHide: if self == CraftForge.mouseOver then if not InCombatLockdown() then CraftForgeFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end CraftForge.mouseOver = nil end
Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED" then if self == CraftForge.mouseOver then -- CraftForge:SkillButton_OnEnter(CraftForge.mouseOver) end if not InCombatLockdown() then if IsControlKeyDown() then CraftForgeFrame:EnableKeyboard(true) else CraftForgeFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end end end

Scripts.OnLoad: self:RegisterForClicks("LeftButtonUp", "RightButtonUp") self:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end
Scripts.OnHide: if self == CraftForge.mouseOver then if not InCombatLockdown() then CraftForgeFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end CraftForge.mouseOver = nil if CraftForge.gttScale then GameTooltip:SetScale(CraftForge.gttScale) end GameTooltip:Hide() end
Scripts.OnLeave: self:UnregisterEvent("MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED") local ct = _G[self:GetName().."Counts"] local r,g,b = ct:GetTextColor() _G[self:GetName().."Name"]:SetTextColor(r, g, b) CraftForge.mouseOver = nil if CraftForge.gttScale then GameTooltip:SetScale(CraftForge.gttScale) end GameTooltip:Hide()
Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "MODIFIER_STATE_CHANGED" then if self == CraftForge.mouseOver then CraftForge:SkillButton_OnEnter(CraftForge.mouseOver) end if not InCombatLockdown() then if IsControlKeyDown() then CraftForgeFrame:EnableKeyboard(true) else CraftForgeFrame:EnableKeyboard(false) end end end

Scripts.OnEditFocusLost: self:Hide() if (self.originalButton) then self.originalButton:Show() self.originalButton = nil CraftForge:UpdateTradeSkillWindow() end

Scripts.OnClick:
CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() if ( button == "LeftButton" and IsControlKeyDown() ) then
CraftForge:ReagentButtonControlClick(self, button, CraftForge.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) elseif ( button == "LeftButton" and IsShiftKeyDown() ) then
CraftForge:ReagentButtonShiftClick(self, button, CraftForge.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) elseif ( button == "RightButton" ) then CraftForge:ReagentButtonRightClick(self, button, CraftForge.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) else
CraftForge:ReagentButtonOnClick(self, button, CraftForge.selectedSkill, self:GetID()) end

Scripts.OnHide: if CraftForge.fullView then CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() CraftForge:CraftForgeFrameForceClose() end

Scripts.OnClick: CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(CraftForgeFilterDropMenu, CraftForge.InitializeFilterDropdown, "MENU") ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, CraftForgeFilterDropMenu, self, self:GetWidth(), 0)

Scripts.OnEditFocusGained: if IsAltKeyDown() then self:SetText("") else self:HighlightText() end

Scripts.OnVerticalScroll: CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() FauxScrollFrame_OnVerticalScroll(self, offset, CRAFTFORGE_TRADE_SKILL_HEIGHT, CraftForge.SkillList_OnScroll) -- re-apply the text highlight and tooltip (if any) when the button changes under the mouse on scroll event if CraftForge.mouseOver then CraftForge:SkillButton_OnEnter(CraftForge.mouseOver) end

Scripts.OnShow: local hideUncraftable = CraftForge:GetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable") C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowMakeableRecipes(hideUncraftable) if hideUncraftable then self:SetChecked(true) else self:SetChecked(false) end
Scripts.OnClick: if button=="LeftButton" then CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() if self:GetChecked() then PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_MAINMENU_OPTION_CHECKBOX_ON) -- "igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn" end local before = CraftForge:GetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable") CraftForge:SetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable", not before) C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowMakeableRecipes(not before) CraftForge:PrintTradeSkillFilter() CraftForge.dataScanned = false CraftForge:SortAndFilterRecipes() CraftForge:UpdateTradeSkillWindow() else if CraftForgeInventoryFilterBag:IsVisible() then CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() else CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Show() end if CraftForge:GetTradeSkillOption("hideuncraftable") then self:SetChecked(true) else self:SetChecked(false) end end

GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(PROFESSIONS_USE_BEST_QUALITY_REAGENTS, nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()

GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(CraftForge.L["Select skill difficulty threshold"], nil, nil, nil, nil, true) GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnClick: CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_MAINMENU_OPTION_CHECKBOX_ON) -- "igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn" local bottom = self:GetBottom() local top = self:GetTop() local x,y = GetCursorPosition() local scale = CraftForgeFrame:GetEffectiveScale() local newLevel = math.floor(4*(y/scale-bottom)/(top-bottom+1)+1) CraftForge:SetTradeSkillOption("filterLevel", newLevel) if newLevel > 1 then C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowSkillUpRecipes(true) else C_TradeSkillUI.SetOnlyShowSkillUpRecipes(false) end CraftForge:PrintTradeSkillFilter() self:Hide() CraftForgeRecipeDifficultyButton:Show() CraftForge.dataScanned = false CraftForge:SortAndFilterRecipes() CraftForge:UpdateTradeSkillWindow()

Scripts.OnClick:
CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() local link = CraftForge:GetRecipeItemLink(CraftForge.selectedSkill) if ( button == "LeftButton" and IsControlKeyDown() ) then
DressUpItemLink(link) elseif ( button == "LeftButton" and IsShiftKeyDown() ) then
if not ChatEdit_InsertLink(link) then CraftForge:XMLDebugLink("CraftForgeSkillIcon: link= ", link) end elseif ( button == "LeftButton" and IsAltKeyDown() ) then
CraftForge:ReagentsLinkOnClick(self, CraftForge.selectedSkill, self:GetID(), IsControlKeyDown()) elseif ( button == "RightButton" ) then
if ( IsShiftKeyDown() ) then CraftForge:AdjustNumberMade(CraftForge.selectedSkill,-1) else CraftForge:AdjustNumberMade(CraftForge.selectedSkill,1) end end
Scripts.OnEvent: if GameTooltip:IsVisible() and GameTooltip:IsOwned(self) then if ( CraftForge.selectedSkill ~= -1 ) then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_TOPLEFT") CraftForge:SetTradeSkillToolTip(CraftForgeFrame.selectedSkill) end end

Scripts.OnClick: CraftForge:InventoryFilterButtons_Hide() if CraftForge:IsShoppingListVisible() then CraftForge:HideShoppingList() else CraftForge:DisplayShoppingList(false) end

Scripts.OnShow: PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_BACKPACK_OPEN) -- "igBackPackOpen" if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end
Scripts.OnHide: PlaySound(SOUNDKIT.IG_BACKPACK_CLOSE) -- "igBackPackClose" if not InCombatLockdown() then self:EnableKeyboard(false) end GameTooltip:Hide()
